_comment: Read by discover_skills.py and the orchestrator. Two purposes: (1) skill_roots tell WHERE each runtime installs skills, for cross-runtime discovery; (2) subagent_support + work_dir describe a runtime WHEN IT IS THE HOST running skill-review (drives isolation mode and the skill's own work directory). Paths use ~ (expanded via Path.home()) and may contain glob segments. needs_verification=true means the path is a best guess to confirm at build/run time.

profiles.name: claude-code
profiles.install_cmd_hint: copy the audited folder into ~/.claude/skills/<name>/ (or npx skills add)

profiles.name: openclaw
profiles.install_cmd_hint: place the audited folder under the relevant skills/ or extensions/<ext>/skills/ root

profiles.name: hermes
profiles._note: Hermes home is $HERMES_HOME (default ~/.hermes; eval/test homes ~/.hermes-testN). Per-profile session-generated skills live in $HERMES_HOME/skills (wiped on reset). Hermes reads the same SKILL.md, plus an optional metadata.hermes block (tags/related_skills). The built-in (install-dir) skill root differs per Hermes build and is not auto-discovered - pass --root for it. If $HERMES_HOME is set to a non-default path, pass --root $HERMES_HOME/skills.
profiles.install_cmd_hint: place under $HERMES_HOME/skills (default ~/.hermes/skills); built-in skills live in the Hermes install dir

profiles.name: generic
profiles.install_cmd_hint: pass --root <dir> for each skills directory this runtime uses
